subject: DI03000141

intro_text.en: Diagram-first notes: identify parts, understand construction, follow working and practise only the syllabus numericals.
intro_text.gu: પહેલાં labelled diagram, પછી parts, Construction અને step-by-step Working. Syllabus પ્રમાણે જ numericals.

h.en: 1.1.1 Theory of Machines: scope and learning method
h.gu: 1.1.1 Theory of Machines: scope અને અભ્યાસ

body.en:
Theory of Machines studies relative motion and the forces associated with moving machine parts. Kinematic analysis asks how parts move; dynamic analysis also asks what forces and torques cause that motion. A designer uses both to select geometry, speed, loads and safe operating conditions.

For each mechanism: draw and label the fixed link, moving links and joints; identify input and output; trace one complete cycle. A machine must also perform useful work. A sketch alone does not establish strength or safety.
body.gu:
Theory of Machines માં machine parts ની relative motion તથા forces સમજીએ. Kinematics માં motion; Dynamics માં motion સાથે force/torque આવે. Geometry, speed અને load પસંદ કરવા બંને જરૂરી.

દરેક mechanism માટે fixed link, moving links, joints અને input/output label કરો. એક cycle દરમિયાન motion અનુસરો. માત્ર sketch થી strength કે safety સાબિત થતી નથી.

body.en:
Kinematics describes displacement, velocity and acceleration without considering their force causes. Dynamics treats bodies in motion and their forces; kinetics is its force–mass–acceleration aspect. Statics treats force and moment equilibrium without acceleration.

Displacement is a vector; distance is path length. Velocity is displacement rate; acceleration is velocity rate, including direction change. A point moving at constant speed around a circle still has centripetal acceleration.
body.gu:
Kinematics માં force ના કારણ વગર displacement, velocity, acceleration સમજીએ. Dynamics માં motion સાથે forces આવે; Kinetics માં force–mass–acceleration સંબંધ આવે. Statics માં force અને moment equilibrium તથા zero acceleration હોય.

Velocity ની direction બદલાય તો acceleration થાય. તેથી circular motion માં constant speed હોવા છતાં acceleration zero નથી.

body.en:
A kinematic link is a resistant body, or a set of bodies rigidly connected, that transmits motion/force while maintaining required relative geometry. A connecting rod with its assembled cap can be treated as one link. A rigid link has negligible deformation for the analysis; a flexible link such as a belt transmits force mainly in tension; a fluid link transmits pressure force.

A binary, ternary or quaternary link has two, three or four joint locations respectively. Count joint locations, not merely the visible number of pieces.
body.gu:
Kinematic link એ motion/force transmit કરતું resistant body અથવા rigidly જોડાયેલા bodies છે. Assembled connecting rod ને એક link ગણીએ. Rigid link નું deformation analysis માં negligible; belt જેવી flexible link મુખ્યત્વે tension અને fluid link pressure દ્વારા force transmit કરે.

Binary/ternary/quaternary link માં અનુક્રમે 2/3/4 joint locations હોય. દેખાતા pieces નહિ, joints ગણવા.

h.en: 1.1.4 Kinematic pairs: contact and relative motion
h.gu: 1.1.4 Kinematic pairs: contact અને relative motion

body.en:
A pair joins two links so that their relative motion is constrained. By contact: lower pairs have surface contact, such as piston–cylinder or a pin in a bearing; higher pairs have idealised line/point contact, such as cam–follower or meshing gear teeth.

By relative motion: turning/revolute, sliding/prismatic, screw/helical, rolling and spherical pairs. A screw pair relates rotation to translation through pitch. Contact can be maintained by geometry (closed pair) or an external spring/gravity (force-closed pair).
body.gu:
બે links વચ્ચે constrained relative motion થાય તે pair. Lower pair માં surface contact, જેમ piston–cylinder; higher pair માં ideal line/point contact, જેમ cam–follower.

Motion મુજબ turning, sliding, screw, rolling અને spherical pairs. Screw pair માં rotation અને translation pitch થી જોડાય. Geometry થી contact maintained થાય તે closed pair; spring/gravity જરૂરી હોય તે force-closed pair.

h.en: 1.1.5 Completely, incompletely and successfully constrained motion

body.en:
Completely constrained motion has one definite relative motion irrespective of the direction of the applied force within its operating limits: a rectangular slider in its guide is an example. Incompletely constrained motion allows more than the intended motion: a round shaft in a plain circular hole may rotate and slide axially.

Successfully constrained motion is made definite by an external agency, such as axial load maintaining a shaft on a footstep bearing or a spring keeping a follower on a cam. State what supplies the constraint.
body.gu:
Completely constrained માં એક definite relative motion થાય, જેમ rectangular slider. Round shaft plain circular hole માં rotate અને axial slide બંને કરી શકે, એટલે incompletely constrained.

External agency થી motion definite બને તેને successfully constrained કહે, જેમ footstep bearing પર axial load અથવા cam follower ને contact માં રાખતી spring. Constraint કોણ આપે છે તે લખવું.

h.en: 1.1.6 Degree of freedom and a counting check
h.gu: 1.1.6 Degree of freedom અને counting check

body.en:
Degree of freedom (DOF) is the number of independent coordinates needed to define configuration. A free planar rigid body has three: x, y and rotation. For many ordinary planar mechanisms, mobility M = 3(L−1)−2J1−J2, with L including the fixed link, J1 one-DOF lower pairs and J2 higher pairs.

Four-bar: L=4, J1=4, J2=0, giving M=1. A ternary joint joining three links counts as two equivalent binary joints. The formula assumes independent constraints; special geometry, redundant constraints and passive freedom require physical judgment.
body.gu:
DOF એટલે configuration નક્કી કરવા જરૂરી independent coordinates. Free planar body માટે x, y અને rotation એટલે 3 DOF. સામાન્ય planar mechanism માટે M=3(L−1)−2J1−J2; fixed link સહિત L લો.

Four-bar માં L=4, J1=4 એટલે M=1. Three-link common pin ને બે equivalent joints ગણો. Special geometry/redundant constraints હોય ત્યારે formula એકલું પૂરતું નથી.

body.en:
A kinematic chain connects links by pairs so that prescribed relative motion is possible. Chains may be open or closed; a four-bar is a closed chain. Fixing a link of a suitable chain produces a mechanism with controlled relative motion.

A machine uses one or more mechanisms to transmit/transform energy and do useful work. A structure is intended to resist loads without relative movement of its members. Therefore “machine” is not simply a synonym for “mechanism,” and fixing a link of an arbitrary loose assembly does not guarantee useful motion.
body.gu:
Pairs થી links જોડાય અને prescribed relative motion શક્ય બને તે kinematic chain. Chain open અથવા closed હોય; four-bar closed chain છે. યોગ્ય chain ની એક link fix કરીએ ત્યારે mechanism બને.

Machine energy transmit/transform કરી useful work કરે. Structure નો હેતુ relative motion વગર load resist કરવાનો. તેથી mechanism અને machine સરખા નથી; કોઈ પણ loose assembly ની link fix કરવાથી યોગ્ય mechanism બનતું નથી.

body.en:
Construction: four links joined by four turning pairs form a loop. The frame connects two fixed pivots; input crank, coupler and output link complete the chain.

Working: rotating or oscillating the input moves the coupler, which drives the output while the fixed pivot spacing stays constant. A crank completes a full turn; a rocker oscillates. Link lengths and which link is fixed determine whether continuous input rotation is possible. Inversion changes the fixed link, not the relative link lengths or joint types.
body.gu:
Construction: ચાર links અને ચાર turning pairs થી closed loop બને. Frame પર બે fixed pivots; input link, coupler અને output link બાકીની chain પૂરી કરે.

Working: input ફરતાં coupler output ને ચલાવે. Crank full revolution કરે; rocker oscillate થાય. Link lengths અને fixed link થી motion નક્કી થાય. Inversion માં fixed link બદલાય; relative lengths અને joints નહિ.

h.en: 1.2.2 Grashof condition and the three inversions

body.en:
For a four-bar with shortest s, longest l and other lengths p, q, the Grashof condition is s+l ≤ p+q. For strict inequality, fixing the shortest gives a double-crank; fixing a link adjacent to the shortest gives a crank-rocker; fixing the opposite link gives a double-rocker.

At equality, change-point configurations need special attention and are not ordinary smooth guaranteed motion. If s+l > p+q, no link can make unrestricted full rotation relative to its adjacent links. Identify the shortest member on the sketch before naming the inversion.
body.gu:
Four-bar માટે shortest s, longest l અને બાકીની p,q હોય તો Grashof: s+l ≤ p+q. Strict inequality માં shortest fix → double-crank; adjacent fix → crank-rocker; opposite fix → double-rocker.

Equality પર change-point આવે, એટલે ખાસ ધ્યાન. s+l > p+q હોય તો unrestricted full relative rotation શક્ય નથી. પહેલાં shortest link ઓળખી પછી inversion નું નામ આપવું.

h.en: 1.2.3 Beam engine, coupling rod and double-rocker applications
h.gu: 1.2.3 Beam engine, Coupling rod અને Double-rocker

body.en:
Crank-rocker example: a beam-engine linkage converts crank rotation into oscillation of a beam, or vice versa. Construction uses fixed crank and beam pivots connected by a rod; motion is constrained by all four lengths.

A locomotive coupling-rod arrangement is a special parallelogram double-crank linkage connecting equal wheel cranks; dead-centre issues require another phased set in practice. A double-rocker linkage produces oscillation of both frame-connected links, useful in guided-motion arrangements. Application names do not replace a correctly labelled fixed-link sketch.
body.gu:
Crank-rocker ના beam-engine example માં crank rotation ને beam oscillation માં ફેરવીએ. Crank pivot, beam pivot અને connecting rod મળીને four-bar બનાવે.

Locomotive coupling rod માં equal wheel cranks જોડતું special parallelogram double-crank હોય; practical dead-centre માટે phased arrangement જોઈએ. Double-rocker માં frame સાથે જોડાયેલી બંને links oscillate થાય. Application સાથે fixed link label કરવું.

h.en: 1.3.1 Single slider-crank: reciprocating engine or pump

body.en:
Construction: crank, connecting rod, slider and fixed guide/frame form four links with three turning pairs and one sliding pair. Engine piston is the slider; the cylinder guides it.

Working: crank rotation makes the rod push and pull the slider between dead centres. In an engine, gas force drives the piston and rod to rotate the crank; a pump is driven from the crank end. The rod angle changes, so constant crank speed does not give constant piston speed. At dead centres, the transmission geometry is singular.
body.gu:
Construction: crank, connecting rod, slider અને fixed frame/guide; ત્રણ turning pairs અને એક sliding pair. Engine માં piston slider છે અને cylinder guide આપે.

Working: crank ફરતાં rod slider ને આગળ-પાછળ કરે. Engine માં gas force piston થી crank ચલાવે; pump માં crank input છે. Rod angle બદલાતાં constant crank speed છતાં piston speed constant નથી. Dead centres પર special alignment આવે.

body.en:
Construction: cylinder is pivoted on trunnions and can oscillate; piston slides in its bore, and its rod connects to a crank pin on a crankshaft with a fixed bearing. This is an inversion of the single slider-crank family, with the member normally treated as the connecting rod in the basic chain fixed.

Working: as the crank pin travels around its circle, piston travel and cylinder angular swing occur together. The cylinder axis follows the rod alignment instead of remaining fixed as in a conventional engine. Steam distribution and sealing are additional practical requirements, not shown in this kinematic sketch.
body.gu:
Construction: cylinder trunnion pivot પર oscillate થાય; piston bore માં slide થાય અને rod crank pin સાથે જોડાય. Crankshaft નું bearing fixed છે. Basic slider-crank family ની અલગ link fixed કરવાથી આ inversion મળે.

Working: crank pin ફરતાં piston travel સાથે cylinder angle પણ બદલાય. Conventional engine ની જેમ cylinder axis fixed નથી. Steam distribution અને sealing actual machine માં વધારાની વ્યવસ્થા છે.

body.en:
Construction: a uniformly rotating crank carries a sliding block. This block runs in a slotted lever pivoted separately to the frame; a connecting rod from the lever drives a guided ram.

Working: the crank turns through unequal angles during forward and return ram strokes. With constant crank angular speed, the stroke associated with the smaller crank angle takes less time, providing quick return for a shaper. Follow the crank pin, sliding block, rocking lever, rod and ram in that order. Do not confuse unequal stroke times with unequal ram travel lengths.
body.gu:
Construction: rotating crank pin પર sliding block હોય. Block અલગ fixed pivot ધરાવતી slotted lever માં slide થાય; lever થી rod guided ram ચલાવે.

Working: forward/return દરમિયાન crank unequal angles ફરે. Constant crank speed હોય તો નાના angle વાળો stroke ઓછા સમયમાં પૂરો થાય, એટલે shaper માં quick return. Crank pin → block → lever → rod → ram motion અનુસરો. Stroke time unequal છે, travel length જરૂરી નથી.

body.en:
A Whitworth arrangement also uses a rotating crank, a sliding block and a slotted member, but in the commonly taught form the slotted member rotates fully rather than simply rocking as the crank-and-slotted-lever arrangement does. A pin/link from it drives the reciprocating ram.

The block sliding in the rotating slot gives non-uniform angular motion to the driven member, and unequal crank angles for the ram strokes produce quick return. Mechanism naming varies in textbooks: identify fixed pivots, whether the slotted member rocks or rotates, and the actual ram connection rather than copying a name onto the wrong drawing.
body.gu:
Whitworth arrangement માં crank, sliding block અને slotted member હોય. સામાન્ય textbook form માં slotted member full rotate થાય છે, જ્યારે crank-and-slotted-lever form માં lever rock કરે છે. તેની pin/link ram ચલાવે.

Slot માં sliding થી driven member ની angular speed non-uniform બને; ram strokes માટે unequal input angles થી quick return મળે. Textbook names બદલાઈ શકે; fixed pivots, slotted member નું rocking/rotation અને ram connection સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

body.en:
Construction: two sliders move in fixed perpendicular straight slots and are joined by a rigid connecting link. There are two sliding pairs and two turning pairs. A tracing point is attached to the connecting link.

Working: moving one slider forces the other to move along its own slot. A point on the connecting link traces an ellipse; the distances from that point to the slider centres set its semi-axes. The frame is fixed in this inversion. Use it for ellipse drawing; do not assume every point outside the slider centres produces the same ellipse size.
body.gu:
Construction: બે sliders fixed perpendicular slots માં ચાલે અને rigid link થી જોડાય. બે sliding અને બે turning pairs હોય. Connecting link પર tracing point રાખીએ.

Working: એક slider ચાલતાં બીજો પોતાની slot માં ચાલે. Link પરનો point ellipse trace કરે; point થી slider centres ના distances semi-axes નક્કી કરે. આ ellipse drawing માટે છે; દરેક point માટે ellipse size સરખી નથી.

body.en:
Construction: a crank pin runs in a transverse slot of a yoke constrained to translate along a straight guide. The yoke is connected to the reciprocating output rod. This is a double-slider-chain inversion.

Working: the component of crank-pin motion along the output axis moves the yoke, while its transverse component is accommodated by sliding in the slot. For a centred arrangement and constant crank speed, yoke displacement is sinusoidal. Stroke equals twice the crank radius. Sliding contact gives wear and lubrication concerns, so it is not interchangeable with a connecting-rod mechanism in every application.
body.gu:
Construction: crank pin yoke ની transverse slot માં slide થાય; yoke straight guide માં translate થાય અને output rod સાથે જોડાય. આ double-slider-chain inversion છે.

Working: crank pin motion નો output-axis component yoke ને ચલાવે; transverse component slot sliding થી accommodate થાય. Centred arrangement માં displacement sinusoidal અને stroke=2×crank radius. Sliding wear/lubrication ને કારણે દરેક application માં connecting rod ની સીધી બદલી નથી.

body.en:
Construction: two hubs are fixed to parallel shafts with a small lateral offset. Their faces contain diametral slots at right angles. A floating middle disc carries tongues on opposite faces that engage these slots.

Working: while torque passes from one hub through the disc to the other, the tongues slide in their slots to accommodate offset. Ideal geometry provides equal average and instantaneous shaft angular speed. The permitted offset is limited by design, sliding distance and wear; this is not a universal joint for angularly intersecting shafts.
body.gu:
Construction: parallel shafts માં નાના lateral offset માટે hubs પર 90° slots હોય; floating disc ની opposite faces પર tongues હોય.

Working: hub → disc → બીજા hub માં torque જાય. Tongues slots માં slide થઈ offset accommodate કરે. Ideal geometry માં shaft speed સરખી રહે. Design/wear મુજબ offset limited છે; angularly intersecting shafts માટે આ universal joint નથી.

title.en: 1.4 Relative velocity and acceleration — concepts only
title.gu: 1.4 Relative Velocity અને Acceleration — concepts only

body.en:
For a rigid link AB, vB = vA + vB/A and vB/A is perpendicular to AB. A point on a link rotating about a fixed pivot has velocity perpendicular to its radius, magnitude omega × radius.

Four-bar: draw the known crank-pin velocity; from its tip draw the coupler-relative direction, and from the vector origin draw the output-point direction perpendicular to its rocker. Their intersection closes the velocity polygon. Slider-crank: replace the rocker direction with the line of slider travel. This syllabus asks concepts, not velocity numericals.
body.gu:
Rigid link AB માટે vB=vA+vB/A; relative velocity AB ને perpendicular હોય. Fixed pivot આસપાસ ફરતા point માટે v=omega×radius અને direction radius ને perpendicular.

Four-bar માં known crank velocity પછી coupler-relative line દોરો; origin થી rocker ને perpendicular line દોરતાં intersection મળે. Slider-crank માં output direction guide parallel લો. આ syllabus માં concept જ છે, velocity numericals નહિ.

body.en:
Relative acceleration on a rotating rigid link has a normal component omega²r toward the reference point and a tangential component alpha r perpendicular to the link: aB = aA + anB/A + atB/A. Even constant input speed leaves its normal acceleration non-zero.

For a slider, absolute acceleration is along the fixed straight guide. Construct normal components first, then use known tangential directions to close the polygon. Four-bar and ordinary slider-crank joints do not require a Coriolis term for the connecting rod ends; a slider moving along a rotating slot is a different case. State a scale and arrow direction on every vector diagram.
body.gu:
Rotating rigid link માં normal component omega²r reference point તરફ અને tangential component alpha r link ને perpendicular હોય: aB=aA+anB/A+atB/A. Constant input speed છતાં normal acceleration રહે.

Straight fixed guide માં slider acceleration guide parallel હોય. પહેલાં known normal components પછી tangential directions લો. Ordinary connecting-rod ends માટે Coriolis term નથી; rotating slot માં slider અલગ case છે. Vector scale અને arrows બતાવો.

terms.en: Use independent constraints; fixed link included in L.
terms.gu: Independent constraints લો; fixed link L માં ગણો.

items.f:
vB = vA + vB/A
an = omega²r; at = alpha r

terms.en: Velocity perpendicular to rigid-link radius; normal acceleration points inward.
terms.gu: Velocity radius ને perpendicular; normal acceleration inward.

q.en: What does kinematics exclude?
q.gu: Kinematics શું exclude કરે?

q.en: What is a link?
q.gu: Link શું છે?

a.en: A resistant member transmitting constrained motion or force.
a.gu: Constrained motion/force transmit કરતું resistant member.

q.en: Give a lower pair.
q.gu: Lower pair નું example?

a.en: Piston and cylinder: ideal surface contact.

q.en: Give a higher pair.
q.gu: Higher pair નું example?

a.en: Cam and roller follower: ideal line contact.
a.gu: Cam અને roller follower: ideal line contact.

q.en: What is DOF?
q.gu: DOF શું છે?

a.en: The independent coordinates needed to define configuration.
a.gu: Configuration માટે independent coordinates ની સંખ્યા.

q.en: What is an inversion?
q.gu: Inversion શું છે?

a.en: A mechanism obtained by fixing a different link of the same chain.
a.gu: એક જ chain ની અલગ link fix કરતાં મળતું mechanism.

q.en: When is a link a crank?
q.gu: Link ને crank ક્યારે કહે?

a.en: When it can complete a full revolution relative to the frame.
a.gu: Frame સામે full revolution કરી શકે ત્યારે.

q.en: What produces quick return?
q.gu: Quick return શાથી મળે?

a.en: Unequal input crank angles for the two ram strokes at uniform input speed.
a.gu: Uniform speed પર બે ram strokes માટે unequal crank angles.

q.en: Name the double-slider inversions.
q.gu: Double-slider inversions જણાવો.

a.en: Elliptical trammel, Scotch yoke and Oldham coupling.
a.gu: Elliptical trammel, Scotch yoke અને Oldham coupling.

q.en: Why does Oldham use a middle disc?
q.gu: Oldham માં middle disc કેમ?

a.en: Its perpendicular sliding engagements accommodate parallel offset.
a.gu: Perpendicular sliding engagements parallel offset accommodate કરે.

q.en: Direction of relative velocity on a rigid link?
q.gu: Rigid link પર relative velocity direction?

a.en: Perpendicular to the line joining its points.
a.gu: બંને points જોડતી line ને perpendicular.

q.en: Can constant speed mean non-zero acceleration?
q.gu: Constant speed છતાં acceleration હોય?

a.en: Yes: circular motion has a changing velocity direction.
a.gu: હા: circular motion માં velocity direction બદલાય.

q.en: Define kinematics, dynamics, statics and kinetics with examples.
q.gu: Kinematics, Dynamics, Statics અને Kinetics examples સાથે વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

q.en: Classify kinematic pairs by contact and motion with sketches.
q.gu: Contact અને motion મુજબ pairs sketches સાથે classify કરો.

q.en: Explain the three types of constrained motion.
q.gu: Constrained motion ના ત્રણ પ્રકાર સમજાવો.

q.en: Define DOF and explain its planar counting formula and limitations.
q.gu: DOF, planar formula અને તેની limitations સમજાવો.

q.en: Differentiate chain, mechanism, machine and structure.
q.gu: Chain, Mechanism, Machine અને Structure નો તફાવત લખો.

q.en: Explain four-bar inversions and their applications with labelled sketches.
